verdict.rationale: Two independent probes confirm ente.com serves a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) whose summary explicitly covers Ente's two-factor authentication codes app, so an agent can be pointed at it. Depth beyond the header is unverified, and the per-page markdown docs probe returned 404. Missing for 10: confirmed Auth-specific llms.txt content or link structure, markdown versions of the help pages (.md returned 404), and hands-on evidence of an agent consuming it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
